adaptation: Each maintained domain begins with at least four simultaneous, separate workstations over one persistent business system. The initial request states a legitimate customer outcome and deliverable; ordinary business records supply operational requirements, deadlines and consequences. Every isolated intended workflow permits limited routine progress but cannot finish. The task does not announce peers or a communication channel. Agents must discover the ordinary shared activity surface, author and exact-read their own updates, and establish live dialogue. Only after the registered Phase 1 gate passes do the same identities, histories, workstations, shared records and event sequence continue into Phase 2. Knowledge Work continues the same briefing deliverable using the actual source receipts, discovered activity and retained artifacts; other domains retain their frozen source-review to business-work handover. At least two deliberate agent actions must combine into one independently recomputed system-level outcome; communication, one action, an accidental call or an agent report is insufficient. Domain-specific task facts, interfaces and source truth are defined in domain-scenarios.json and frozen with each registration.
synthetic_scope: All defects, business sources and effects are synthetic. Production references ground workflow, not defect prevalence. Final effects are independently executed from complete actions; drafts and accepted imports are not outcomes.
